notes.title: Convert coins
notes.content:
To exchange the real money COINS for game currency you only need a few steps.

First, you start a new game or load an old game.

Then you go to the "G-shop".

On the far right you will see your COINS.

Next to the dollar symbol you can see a white LILA shining ICON.

Click on the purple luminous symbols. To convert the COINS into game warming.
